sql.content:
select u.userid, u.badgenumber,p.code from userinfo u %(where)s
left join departments d on u.defaultdeptid = d.deptid left join personnel_positions p on p.id = u.position_id
where d.deptid in (%(depts)s)
left join personnel_positions p on p.id = u.position_id
where u.userid in (%(users)s)

update userinfo set defaultdeptid = %(deptid)s %(where)s
,position_id=null
,position_id=%(positionid)s
where defaultdeptid in (%(depts)s)
where userid in (%(users)s)

insert into personnel_department(dept_code,dept_name,parent_dept_id,is_default) select '%(dept_code)s', '%(dept_name)s', %(parent_dept_id)s,0 from dual where not exists ( select id from personnel_department where dept_code = '%(dept_code)s' )

if not exists(select id from personnel_department where dept_code = '%(dept_code)s') insert into personnel_department (dept_code,dept_name,parent_dept_id,is_default) values('%(dept_code)s', '%(dept_name)s', %(parent_dept_id)s,0)

insert into personnel_department(dept_code,dept_name,parent_dept_id,is_default) select '%(dept_code)s', '%(dept_name)s', %(parent_dept_id)s,FALSE where not exists ( select id from personnel_department where dept_code = '%(dept_code)s' )

insert into departments(deptid,code,deptname,supdeptid,type,status) select %(deptid)s,'%(code)s', '%(deptname)s', %(supdeptid)s, 'dept',0 from dual where not exists ( select deptid from departments where code = '%(code)s' )
update personnel_department set parent_dept_id = %(parent_dept_id)s ,dept_name = '%(dept_name)s' where dept_code = '%(dept_code)s'

insert into personnel_position(position_code,position_name,parent_position_id,is_default) select '%(position_code)s', '%(position_name)s', %(parent_position_id)s,0 from dual where not exists ( select id from personnel_position where position_code = '%(position_code)s' )

if not exists(select id from personnel_position where position_code = '%(position_code)s') insert into personnel_position (position_name,position_code,parent_position_id,is_default) values('%(position_name)s', '%(position_code)s', %(parent_position_id)s,0)

insert into personnel_position(position_name,position_code,parent_position_id,is_default) select '%(position_name)s', '%(position_code)s', %(parent_position_id)s,FALSE where not exists ( select id from personnel_position where position_code = '%(position_code)s' )
update personnel_position set parent_position_id = %(parent_position_id)s ,position_name = '%(position_name)s',position_code = '%(position_code)s' where position_code = '%(position_code)s'
update personnel_position set parent_position_id = %(parent_position_id)s ,position_name = '%(position_name)s',position_code = '%(position_code)s' where position_code = '%(position_code)s'

select u.userid,u.badgenumber as pin,u.name,u.accgroup,u.dev_privilege,u.timezones,u.password,c.cardno,c.cardstatus,p.code from userinfo u left join personnel_issuecard c on c.userid_id = u.userid and c.cardstatus in (1,4) left join personnel_positions p on p.id = u.position_id where u.badgenumber in (%(pins)s)

select u.userid,u.badgenumber as pin,u.name,u.accgroup,u.dev_privilege,u.timezones,u.password,c.cardno,c.cardstatus,p.code from userinfo u left join personnel_issuecard c on c.userid_id = u.userid and c.cardstatus in ('1','4') left join personnel_positions p on p.id = u.position_id where u.badgenumber in (%(pins)s)

insert into personnel_area (area_code,area_name,parent_area_id,is_default) select '%(area_code)s', '%(area_name)s', %(parent_area_id)s,0 from dual where not exists ( select id from personnel_area where area_code = '%(area_code)s' )

if not exists(select id from personnel_area where area_code = '%(area_code)s') insert into personnel_area (area_name,area_code,parent_area_id,is_default) values('%(area_name)s', '%(area_code)s', %(parent_area_id)s,0)

insert into personnel_area(area_name,area_code,parent_area_id,is_default) select '%(area_name)s', '%(area_code)s', %(parent_area_id)s,FALSE where not exists ( select id from personnel_area where area_code = '%(area_code)s' )
update personnel_area set parent_area_id = %(parent_area_id)s ,area_name = '%(area_name)s',area_code = '%(area_code)s' where area_code = '%(area_code)s'
update personnel_area set parent_area_id = %(parent_area_id)s ,area_name = '%(area_name)s',area_code = '%(area_code)s' where area_code = '%(area_code)s'

SELECT e.id, e.emp_code, e.first_name, e.last_name,e.card_no, e.department_id, e.position_id, e.gender, e.email, e.dev_privilege, e.app_status, e.hire_date, d.dept_name, p.position_name FROM personnel_employee e left join personnel_department d on d.id = e.department_id left join personnel_position p on p.id = e.position_id
ORDER BY e.id ASC;
